svg.title: Mac Channels main-window design
svg.desc: Native three-column window at 1280 by 840 points with a 248-point channel source list, a 720-point conversation and a 312-point Overview inspector. Glass is limited to navigation and controls. Example content illustrates a pending question, unread divider, agent run and composer.

g.text: Make the next release feel effortless.

text.tspan: The team has a clear plan for the release. I need one decision
Should the first launch open your most recent channel,
or show the full channel list?
The layouts look lovely. Keep the conversation
quiet and the navigation unmistakably Mac.
The native direction is ready: a source list, a paper-like
conversation and a true inspector. Agent colors carry identity.
Glass belongs to the controls, not the messages.

g.text: Reply to Lead, or @mention an agent

text.tspan: Make the next release feel effortless.
A focused team for the details that

g.text: A working team. A quiet conversation.
1280 x 840 pt window - native materials, system typography, exact agent identities
